title: Delicious Adana Kebap with Turkish-Style Roasted Swede
description: A flavorful and spicy Turkish-inspired dish featuring tender Adana kebap served with a delicious side of roasted Swede.

ingredients.name: Adana kebap
ingredients.notes: Available in most supermarkets or make your own

instructions: Peel and chop the Swede into 2cm cubes and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with Turkish olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the Adana kebap in a pan over medium heat for 5-7 minutes per side.
Slice the cooked kebap into thin strips and serve with the roasted Swede and crunchy salad mix.
Drizzle with zesty lemon juice and serve immediately.
